_README: The two ledger cells no machine can know: `Waiver?` and `Note`.
Keyed by DEPLOY RUN ID -- the number the Forgejo UI shows (index_in_repo), e.g. 705.
NOT the API's own `id`, which is a different and larger number (705 is id 1618).
A run with no entry here renders EMPTY cells and the generator exits 0 -- a missing
annotation is the normal case for a fresh release, never an error.
No pipe characters: a pipe shifts every later column, the rule docs/prod-releases.md
already states for its own Note column. The generator replaces one with '/' rather than
corrupting the table, but do not rely on that -- write the cell correctly.
`waiver` is MANDATORY on any real release row per docs/prod-releases.md's column table:
either `none`, or the D-number AND BOTH halves of RVC-v1.1's scope (time-boxed AND
single-candidate). A blank cell is not a valid approval record -- the generator cannot
enforce that and does not pretend to.
Example, for shape only -- this run id is a pre-epoch rehearsal and will never be a row:
